RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 15

An all-female panel is weak evidence by itself. Panels often reflect who holds senior roles, and same-sex panels routinely hire candidates of the other sex. A head-of-group role also weighs leadership, business development and client relationships, not just years of design work, so a candidate with eight years could reasonably be preferred. Raising the panel's composition now would likely look like an accusation without support and could damage your reputation in a small industry.

Instead, chase your feedback request politely in writing and ask how candidates were scored against the criteria. If the answer is evasive, inconsistent with the advertised criteria, or reveals other concerning patterns, then consider a formal query or advice from an employment adviser.
